Lp exponent2 denotes the complete real space of measurable square-integrable almost-everywhere classes for an arbitrary measure. No finiteness of the measure or dimension of Lp is assumed.
ContinuousLinearMap is a bounded linear operator. Multiplication of endomorphisms is composition. IsPositive means symmetry and nonnegative real quadratic form, with the real Hilbert inner product.
The conclusion is positive operator order. There is no commutation or nontriviality assumption; any functional-calculus instances used in a proof are internal and are not binders.
